notes.title: Announcing Rip Current, a new dinosaur horror game coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33960973/519559c9263e5682dbc7c9934f4614917b8064fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From the makers of [i][u]Oakwood [/u][/i]comes a new dinosaur horror game, delivering a tense and atmospheric experience where players must face off against ancient predators born from humanity’s desperation to save Earth’s oceans.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Survive the prehistoric apex predators stalking the abyss of Post Salvos.[/i] 
[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1557220/Rip_Current/"]Rip Current[/url] is a single-player, action-adventure game set in the depths of an aquatic research facility where humanity’s desperation to save the planet has birthed something far worse. You play as Carter, a special operations contractor sent to investigate the sudden radio silence from Post Salvos, the facility at the heart of the project. Upon arrival, it becomes clear that the experiment has gone wrong. The station is in ruins, flooded and overrun by engineered predators: chief among them, a ferocious and relentless spinosaurus.[/p][p]
Explore the sprawling, aquatic research station. Navigate tight corridors, flooded labs, and evade the creatures that stalk the waters below and the darkness ahead. Sneak, run or fight your way through the unleashed predators as you piece together what happened to the lost souls of Post Salvos.

[i][b]Rip Current [/b][/i]will launch September 23, 2025, on Steam PC.
Wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1557220/Rip_Current/"]here[/url] and be sure to check out the [url="https://youtu.be/8bh9wKyqKIM?si=QGg9_eBal_oK7BuR"]trailer[/url]! 

[/p]

notes.title: Halloween Haunt Event
notes.notes: Halloween has arrived in Oakwood, and some sneaky ghoul has been placing pumpkins around the campground! Are you keen enough to find all five pumpkins to reveal to a new spooktacular ending? Hurry, before time runs out! Event runs from October 25th to October 31st.
